primary.meaning:
- căn nguyên (tính từ)
- căn bản (tính từ)
- thuộc về nguyên thủy (tính từ)
- trước hết (tính từ)
- đầu (tính từ)
- đầu tiên (tính từ)
- nguyên nhân đầu tiên (danh từ)
- phần cơ bản (danh từ)

definitions: not derived from, caused by, or based on anything else; original.
(of an organic compound) having its functional group located on a carbon atom which is bonded to no more than one other carbon atom.
denoting or relating to organisms that produce organic compounds from simple substances such as water and carbon dioxide, typically by photosynthesis.
relating to or denoting the input side of a device using electromagnetic induction, especially in a transformer.
(in the US) a preliminary election to appoint delegates to a party conference or to select the candidates for a principal, especially presidential, election.
(in the US) run against (the current holder of a political office) in the preliminary election a party uses to select its candidate for the general election.

examples: the primary stage of their political education
his expert handling of the primary and secondary literature is clear on every page
seed-eating birds and herbivorous insects are primary consumers

alongside.meaning:
- chạy dài theo (trạng từ)
- ghé dọc theo (trạng từ)
- tàu đậu (trạng từ)

definitions: close to the side of; next to.

examples: alongside the development of full-time courses there had to be provision for the part-time student
the road passes alongside the viaduct
I worked alongside him for many weeks

definitions: a style of Japanese film and television animation, typically aimed at adults as well as children.

definitions: (of a term) used to include every individual of the class to which it refers.

examples: the distributed supplies are meticulously monitored to make sure everyone gets their share
the figures of syllogisms all have properly distributed middle terms

definitions: a hard, dark, enamel-like varnish containing asphalt, used to give a black gloss to metal objects.
cover (something) with a hard black varnish.

examples: the pillars are to be japanned
